neighbours.label: piece of a compound technical identifier, e.g. 'easting'/'northing' or 'date_low'/'date_high'
fire: Coordinates are given as easting and northing in meters.
The grid reference lists the easting first and then the northing.
Surveyors record a false easting of 500,000 meters.
quiet: Coordinates are given as distances east and north in meters.
The grid reference lists the east distance first and then the north one.
Surveyors record an offset of 500,000 meters.
